Hints: Vertical angles are opposite each other when two lines intersect
Solution: At intersecting straight lines, each vertical angle is supplementary to the same neighboring angle. Their measures are therefore equal.

Question Choices: Select the angle relationship for angles in the exact same position at each intersection where a transversal crosses parallel lines: ~~Alternate | Interior | Corresponding | Vertical~~
Solution: Angles occupying the same relative position at the two intersections are corresponding angles. Parallel lines make their measures equal; alternate angles occupy opposite sides of the transversal, and vertical angles share one intersection.

Question Choices: Fill: Alternate exterior angles are strictly \_\_\_ (equal/supplementary) when lines are parallel.
Hints: Alternate means opposite sides of the transversal
Solution: A transversal cutting two parallel lines makes alternate interior angles equal and alternate exterior angles equal.

Question Choices: Fill: A transversal crosses two parallel lines. Its same-side interior angles add up to \_\_\_ degrees.
Solution: For two parallel lines cut by a transversal, same-side interior angles are supplementary, so their measures total 180°.

Question Choices: Fill: A straight line forms an angle that measures \_\_\_ degrees.
Hints: It is exactly half of a full 360-degree circle
Solution: A straight angle is half a full turn: 360÷2=180°.
